title: Byrna Goes to the Lone Star Rally
summary: Byrna sponsored the Lone Star Rally in Galveston, TX. See how riders reacted to less-lethal self-defense: easy to use, virtually no recoil, impressive accuracy.
body_markdown:
# Byrna at the Lone Star Rally: Less-Lethal Self-Defense for Texas Riders


Byrna was proud to sponsor this year's Lone Star Rally in Galveston, Texas. All weekend long, riders and rally-goers stopped by our trailer and shooting pod to see what Byrna is all about and try it for themselves. For many of them, it was their first hands-on experience with


**less-lethal self-defense** , and their reactions said it all.


## 1. Easy to Use, Even for First-Time Shooters


Attendees ranged from first-time shooters to experienced firearm owners, and the feedback was consistent: Byrna is easy to pick up and use. Some people walked over after watching others take a few shots and wanted to see what it felt like.


"It was easy. It felt really good and light in my hand," one attendee told us. That lightweight, comfortable feel makes Byrna approachable for anyone, whether they've been shooting for years or are holding a launcher for the first time.


## 2. Virtually No Recoil and Impressive Accuracy


Recoil came up again and again at the shooting pod. Experienced shooters noticed right away how little kick Byrna has compared to a traditional firearm, and that made it easier to stay on target shot after shot.


"No recoil, good impact on the target, good accuracy. Just awesome all the way around," said one rider. Another attendee who has shot plenty of guns told us recoil is usually the hardest part, and without it, hitting the target came more naturally.


## 3. Discovering a New Option for Personal Safety


For a lot of visitors, the rally was their first introduction to Byrna. "When I heard about you guys, I didn't even know there was something like this out there," one attendee said, explaining that most people assume their only choices are pepper spray, a taser, or a gun.


Byrna gives people another option: a less-lethal alternative to carrying a traditional firearm. Many visitors came over to shoot a few rounds and, as one attendee put it, "I was sold."


## Thank You, Lone Star Rally


By day three, we were practically sold out, and the trailer and shooting pod were never empty. Thank you to everyone who stopped by, gave Byrna a try, and shared their experience with us.


**Personal safety doesn't have to be complicated.**


[Watch the full video on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7GHT7RSqx_E) to hear from the riders who tried Byrna in Galveston, and see why so many of them walked away ready to make less-lethal part of their everyday safety plan.
